preconditions.description: The dimensions of the sheet of paper are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(grid) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid has exactly n rows and each row has exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'#', '.'} for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either '#' (painted) or '.' (not painted).

preconditions.expression: any(cell == '#' for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: There is at least one painted square in the grid.

postconditions.description: The output is a valid integer within the range of possible deletions.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (is_connected(grid) and not is_connected(remove_squares(grid, return_value)))
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if it's impossible to disconnect the set, otherwise it's the minimum number of squares to delete to disconnect the set.
